spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact static Iterator.zip(iterables) with two or three live inputs, demonstrates default-shortest truncation with closed leftovers, and proves the Iterator Helper return type by chaining .map() directly off the zip; semantics verified against real V8 15.0 via a 29-case model-vs-native differential test.

interactive.rationale: Three editable inputs, an arity change (blank C vs filled C), a chain toggle, and a run button all change the live tuple output, the count note, and the code echo.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises live-edited sequences zipped into tuples chained into iterator helpers, which is what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unequal lengths (shortest count shown in the note), empty shortest input, and two-vs-three arity; deeper failure paths are explicitly delegated to edge-lab and the option space to mode-matrix.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6249068542164992 and the spec's Iterator.zip section directly.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite pins zip-basic-tuples, zip-default-mode-shortest and zip-result-is-iterator-helper — exactly the contracts this page demonstrates; all 17 assertions verified passing on real V8 15.0 and guarded negatives fail honestly on non-implementing browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP (page-driver zip-basics, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): 4 tuples for the default inputs, chained .map output "ceres — 1801"…, arity-3 run truncating to 2 tuples with the note reporting lengths [4,4,2] → 2; zero console errors, zero failed requests. Screenshots: zip-basics.png (desktop 1280), m-zip-zip-basics.png (mobile 360x740, post-interaction, scrollWidth 360).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts zip-basics-shortest-count (row count equals shortest input length) after every run plus the shared joint-iteration-banner-honest assert; error paths assert zip-basics-ran false with details.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; engine tags accent-emerald/amber with bg-ivory text; buttons keep the paired background/color override; focus-visible outlines on all controls.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled text inputs, a real checkbox with a for-linked label, <output> result (implicit polite live region), role=status count note, keyboard-scrollable code echo, native buttons with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Input grid collapses to a single column via auto-fit minmax; scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 mobile emulation post-interaction (m-zip-zip-basics.png); responsive-check for the feature reports desktop clean and mobile OK.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate laziness explicitly with an infinite generator input
openQuestions.detail: The page states zip is lazy but both editable inputs are finite arrays. A small additional control that zips against an infinite counter generator (with .take(n) guarding consumption) would let visitors observe laziness directly rather than take it from prose. The edge-lab's case 8 partially covers this with its infinite tracked generators.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with auto-fit/minmax(min(100%,…)) for input groups so they reflow to one column on narrow viewports; keep single-axis control rows in wrapping flex.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The three inputs live in .inputs { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr)) }; the run/chain controls are a wrapping flex row; verified scrollWidth 360 on mobile.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every control, use native checkbox/button elements, and surface dynamic results through output/status live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All inputs have <label for>; the chain toggle is a native checkbox in a 44px row; results are an <output> plus a role=status note; the availability banner is a labelled note.

summary: Basic/canonical angle for Iterator.zip: the smallest real call over live-edited inputs, with default-shortest semantics made visible in a count note and the Iterator Helper return type proven by chaining .map() — the advanced-composition angle folded into the canonical page. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 (labelled spec-model path, honest absent banner) with native-path semantics pinned by the differential test on V8 15.0.
